captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a professional telephoto zoom lens with a long, stepped cylindrical barrel finished in matte black. It features a wide, ribbed zoom ring near the rear section, a ribbed focus ring near the front, and a central rotating tripod collar with a mounting foot. The lens elements at both ends are depicted with dark glass-like materials, and the rings are designed to rotate independently around the central axis of the barrel.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a telephoto zoom lens with a stepped black barrel, a ribbed focus ring near the front, a ribbed zoom ring near the rear, and a central tripod collar with an attached mounting foot. Ensure the focus ring, zoom ring, and tripod collar are set up with revolute or continuous rotational joints around the main barrel axis.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining a series of coaxial cylindrical shapes for the main barrel sections. Ribbed textures on the focus and zoom rings are created using patterned arrays of small rectangular cuts or additions on cylinder surfaces. The tripod foot is built from a combination of a thin cylindrical collar and a rectangular support block. The assembly uses revolute joints aligned along the Z-axis to connect the rotating zoom ring, focus ring, and tripod collar to the static barrel base.
